As of my last update, Starbucks actually discontinued the "Gold" status tier in their rewards program several years ago. 

Under the current Starbucks Rewards program, you generally earn "Stars" for your purchases which can be redeemed for various rewards (like free drinks, food, or merchandise) at different star levels, but there is no longer a separate "Gold" status tier to achieve.
